description: SC11's banned environment-variable and override names. No shipped code in governance-git/ or git-tools/ may read any of these, from the environment or by parsing a command-string token; no fallback resolves any of them. The path they once carried is computed deterministically instead.
input: The source trees of governance-git/ and git-tools/.
output: A grep-style verification finds zero reads of any listed name (env or command-string token); any hit is a hard failure.
invariants: No runtime read, and no command-string token parse, of any listed name.
This artifact is the single source of truth the SC10/SC11 verification greps against; adding a newly-banned name here extends the check with no code change.
